**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — deviation (fallback target).**

- **What exists:** § 11.4 (p0192) provides "Termination Assistance" on expiry or any termination, at Customer's expense computed at M&I's then-current rates — so the trigger and rate elements are already met.
- **What fails fallback:** (i) the only quantified period (six months of continued Services) is conditioned on a written request made at least 100 days before expiry, so no assistance duration is assured on a mid-term termination; (ii) nothing anywhere requires return or export of Customer Data — §§ 17.1 and 17.5 only confirm our ownership and M&I's safeguarding duty, and searches for return/export/destruction/deconversion language found nothing else.
- **Cure:** one inserted § 11.5 after p0192 carrying only the two still-missing fallback elements — at least 90 days of Termination Assistance following any expiry or termination, and export/delivery of all Customer Data within 30 days. The existing then-current-rate mechanic and the optional six-month Services continuation are left verbatim, and no machine-readable-format or certified-deletion language was volunteered from the preferred level.
